name: MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV
description: MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV ICU electronic health records, about 60 thousand and 300 thousand admissions. Mortality and length-of-stay phenotyping AUPRC on the Harutyunyan splits. Johnson et al., Scientific Data 2016 and 2023. Distinct from MIMIC-CXR. PhysioNet credential required. Records not vendored.
citation: Johnson et al., Scientific Data 2016. MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.

license.notes: Credentialed PhysioNet access. Clinical records are loader-only and not vendored.
